entry: New, opt-in: Rival Corporation. Switch on the Rival Corporation panel and a scripted straight-line competitor races you. It makes the same goods every cycle but digs up all of its material new and never invests in repair, reuse or recycling, so it is ahead early and its extraction costs climb until it earns almost nothing. The panel shows both funds, how much less you have dug up, and the cycle you pulled ahead. It is the same every time and changes nothing for you. A new achievement, Overtaken, and a story chapter mark the moment.

New, opt-in: Market shocks. Switch them on and a fixed, public schedule of shocks starts: in every block of 15 cycles a price spike (raw material costs x1.5) on cycle 5, a three-cycle port strike that shuts one trade partner from cycle 9 (a different partner each round) and a demand surge on cycle 13 (you need 20% more material). Nothing is random, each shock is announced a cycle early in the status block, and a chain that recovers its own material barely notices. A new achievement, Shock Absorber, rewards closing the loop on five shocked cycles, and the story gains a chapter.

New: a Rewind token. Once per chain you can undo your last Advance Cycle, along with anything you bought since, and go back to the start of that cycle. It shows as a chip in the header (Rewind: 1 left) and as a button in the investments column, asks before it spends the token, and a new chain gives you a new one. Records you have already earned are kept; a cycle that gave surplus to the regional pool cannot be rewound.

New: buy several at once. Pick x1, x5 or x10 above the investments (or shift-click for five) and each buy button shows what the whole purchase will cost. It applies to repair, reuse, recycling and all three trade partners, and buys as many as you can afford. Settings gains 'Ask before big purchases', which checks with you when one purchase would take more than half, 75% or 90% of your funds (off by default).

New: a Copy result button in the Career panel copies a one-line result (score, cycles run, lifetime circular share) to share. Earned achievements now have a Share button, and a Credits link sits at the bottom of the page (in the Help menu on Desktop).

New for Loop: a Perfect Cycle combo (every extra closed cycle in a row banks a growing score bonus, and a miss resets the combo but never takes back what you banked), once-per-chain Streak insurance, a 'So close' note naming the cheapest single purchase when you are a few units short of closing the loop, five name plates (The Scrapper, Fixer, Swapper, Diplomat and Allrounder) earned by closing the loop with different supply mixes, a Career panel with your best results per goods category and a Copy summary button, a secret fourth goods category that opens after you have closed a loop on all three ordinary ones, and three quiet speed-loop achievements. Also: Space, 1, 2, 3 and T work as shortcuts, a spoken summary after every cycle and a plain-list view of the chain for screen readers, the extraction price shown as a worked sum, the tab title follows your cycle, and Settings gains High contrast, an easier-to-read font and a flow animation speed.

New Desktop layout for wide windows: a full-window view with the cycle, funds, environmental damage, circular share and score as chips across the top, the supply chain and the one-item vignette above your damage and loop-closure meters and the trade network (with its optional visual maps), and your circularity investments, trade partners and the regional pool in a column on the right with Advance Cycle pinned at the top. How to Play, Achievements and Settings are icons in the top bar; relabelling your goods, About Loop, feedback, the real story and What's New are windows opened from the Menu (Esc). Pick it from the opening screen; your save carries over and the Classic layout is unchanged.

Regional recycling pool: an opt-in 'Surplus donation' switch gives the supply you would have sold outward to a pool every player shares (you forgo the sale price), and the page shows the pool's running total, today's total and its best day (H11).

Story mode: a short story about a small workshop growing into a circular economy, with a chapter that unlocks alongside each achievement. A Story panel below the title shows the chapters you have reached; the existing Story on/off pill hides it, and it never changes any number or your save (W1).

Optional visual maps for desktop: a Visual network view for your trade partners and a Visual supply chain view for the whole loop, with line thickness and node size scaled to the real units per cycle, animated flow direction, and hover or keyboard details. Smaller screens keep the simple version (H25b, H29b).
The traced unit is now a named product (Nova the phone, Juniper the jacket, Oak the chair) with a short story for every step of its journey and a count of its lives (H7).
Material passport: follow one unit of material through the chain, cycle by cycle, from newly mined to recovered by repair, reuse, recycling or trade (H21).
Consumer behavior: a Repair & Reuse Culture campaign trims the material each cycle needs by 4% per level, a demand-side lever beside the supply-side measures (H17).
Supply chain redesign: once your loop has closed, redesign each measure up to three times for a permanent +5% supply per level (H3).
Circularity scorecard: your circular share against the overall real-world figure and every sector benchmark at once, with a verdict and bars for each (H19).
Waste-stream focus: pick one of Repair, Reuse or Recycling to count 25% higher, free to switch at any time (H9).

Two optional start modes: a Circular design challenge (all circular supply counts at 65%) and a Zero-waste challenge (keep lifetime extraction under 150 units), picked before the first cycle (H13, H23).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).
Fixed the chain-flow visualization overflowing the screen edge on narrow phones.

Each goods-flavor set (electronics/clothing/furniture) now has its own distinct loop story, not just a different noun in the same sentence. The achievement-unlock toast also no longer overlaps with the loop-closed banner.
Fixed a display bug where the Achievements/What's New panels showed as empty boxes before their first open and never visually closed again once opened once.
H5: a new live comparison shows how your lifetime circular share stacks up against other players', once enough chains have been saved to compare against.

Z22 confirmation-dialog audit: "Start New Chain" now goes through the shared ConfirmDialog (matching Grid/Herd/Trade Empire) instead of firing instantly, since it's a full wipe of the current chain's funds, cycle, and investments.

Round-2 wave: a third trade partner (Overseas Consortium), a 25% milestone particle burst, ring-node glow on your top investment, a loop efficiency audit, score-source pie, streak progress, extraction-cost trend arrow, cosmetic goods relabel, a weekly featured category, and a Goods Collector achievement.
Added tooltips to the Trade Link and Regional Partner buttons explaining what each actually buys, closing an onboarding gap for players who skipped the tutorial.

Added a settings panel (text size + reduced motion) and completed a colorblind-safety audit — the linear-chain brown vs. closed-loop green flow particle is already redundantly coded via text and arrow brightness, no change needed.

Achievements system added (20 achievements) plus a large H1-H20 backlog pass: a goods-category picker, a second trade partner, a closed-loop streak tracker, a live score breakdown, and reactive visual pulses on investment.
Full visual redesign: starfield/space-themed backdrop, glass panels, gradient buttons and glowing meter fills.
Fixed load_state() wholesale-replacing circularity investments on load instead of merging key-by-key against the current investment schema.
Pass 3 balance check: confirmed the single-item vignette already gives immediate, strategy-reflective feedback tied to the live circular-supply fraction; added regression tests to lock it in.
Added an in-game Info Page with real-world circular-economy sources; Pass 2 added a trade network and a single-item vignette alongside the abstract flow-chain view.
Iteration pass: animated chain-flow particles (color-coded circular vs. linear paths) and an end-of-session real-world circularity-rate comparison.

All 7 core milestones shipped: linear extraction chain, circularity investments, environmental cost meter, loop-closure visualization, scoring + hope-angle payoff, feedback prompt, and hub integration.
